gate_reasons: Open unknowns U-1 to U-6 carried forward into phase contracts
objective: Evaluate testing capabilities, evidence contract, and reproduction baseline
question: How to establish a robust evidence contract and reproduction baseline for testing professionalization?

questions.text: Can existing deep guards, UI checks, and runtime traps be reused for testing professionalization?
What evidence manifest structure and reproduction protocol are required for auditability?

findings.statement: Existing UI checks and deep guards provide deterministic verification in playwright/tests/support.
Runtime error trapping catches console.error, pageerror, and sanitizes secrets.
Accessibility testing is operational via @axe-core/playwright in login.a11y.spec.ts.
Visual regression testing requires baseline snapshot governance.
Performance testing requires workload profiles and SRE SLO alignment.

evidence.source_title: Codebase UI checks and deep guards
evidence.excerpt: Comprehensive guards in playwright/tests/support/ui-checks.ts and deep-guards.ts.
Automatic trap and secret redaction in playwright/tests/fixtures/runtime-trap.ts.
Playwright test runner includes native support for visual comparisons via toHaveScreenshot.
Thresholds are pass/fail criteria used to specify the performance expectations of the system under test.

existing_implementation.summary: Deep guards, UI checks, and runtime trap exist in playwright/tests/support and fixtures.

reusable_components.capability: Geometry, persistence, and fault recovery guards

constraints.statement: All files must strictly obey Rule 15 code size budget (< 80% yellow zone).

risks.statement: False pass or missing evidence on parallel workers without namespace isolation.

cons: High recurring cost and privacy exposure

implications_for_plan.statement: Dùng evidence hiện có, bổ sung manifest và receipt thay vì viết lại
Tái hiện độc lập và before/after là tiêu chí trọng tâm người dùng
Playwright hỗ trợ screenshot diff, cần baseline governance
A11y đã có; mở rộng workflow, không tạo scan trùng
k6 là candidate; SLO và runner adapter phải spike trước
Đã có HM fault probes; bổ sung property/mutation tổng quát
Reuse API security, mở rộng kiểm soát ứng dụng theo ASVS
Schema validator trước, Pact theo topology thực tế
Async, exploratory và flaky đã có phần nền cần operationalize
Không cài nguyên bộ skill bên ngoài vì trùng rule và traceability
